contract.task_clause:
Which is true about Batch Normalization?
Option A: After applying batch normalization, the layer’s activations will follow a standard Gaussian distribution.
Option B: The bias parameter of affine layers becomes redundant if a batch normalization layer follows immediately afterward.
Option C: The standard weight initialization must be changed when using Batch Normalization.
Option D: Batch Normalization is equivalent to Layer Normalization for convolutional neural networks.
